newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares disaster areas in Maryland.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares disaster areas in Maryland.

text.p: President Clinton Tuesday declared portions of Maryland disaster areas because of flooding caused by Tropical Storm Fran, making victims eligible for federal aid.

The declaration applies to Allegany and Frederick counties. The White House said damage assessments were being conducted in additional counties in the state to determine if they qualify for disaster relief.
Clinton issued the declaration while campaigning in Illinois.
